item.tib: lha chen sbyin sreg lcags kyu 'bum phrag 'bar ba'i 'od zer tsi ta snying bskul
item.coloph: kun grol grags pa ces lha chen po'i sbyin sreg lcags kyu 'bum phrag 'bar ba'i 'od zer tsi ta snying bskul 'di ni rgyal khyung dge bsnyen rtsa ba'i gdung rigs lha dbang g.yung drung mi 'gyur gtsug phud can gyi bka' yis bskul phyir sngags kyi bdag nyid brlams pa'i kho bo kun grol grags pa can gyis gnam lo ang gi ra yi bzhin ras ngom pa mchu zla'i dbang po phyogs su shar phyogs rgyal mo rgya yi rong chen gyi nub phyogs sa yi thig le dge bshes rgyal po'i pho brang du brtsams pa'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos bgyis pa dge legs su gyur cig/
